name: @bust/ios
description: BUST — Capacitor (iOS) shell. Reuses the /web presentation controller + HTML/CSS, bundles /core + a touch input adapter into ios/www, and wraps it as a native iOS project.

scripts.init: node scripts/build.mjs && cap add ios && node scripts/iospatch.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run build && cap sync ios && node scripts/iospatch.mjs
